research_notes: A compact workload template for future probes should include evidence consistency, timing aggregation, failure classification, policy replay, checkpoint integrity, and metric derivation as reusable families.
Each family can consume actual accumulated evidence so the workload remains novel/useful as the study grows.
Bounded extensions can be allowed only while new evidence/questions remain.
This solves the prior exhaustion problem without permitting idle padding.
The current retry effectively prototyped this approach manually.
It can be formalized after close.
